title: Website Pitch & Pricing
format: Call — website pitch, pricing & design direction
tldr: First working call with Flint about taking over the Coatary website. Austin is an investor in Coatary, so the framing is "I'm not trying to charge anything crazy — mostly cover our cost." Plan: drop WordPress + Elementor Pro, keep only the Bluehost domain, and replace it with a custom-coded site ("a boutique web-dev company for the price of a Wix/Squarespace"). Top Rock showed example builds (a character-booking site, the Temple View football-recruiting admin site, the Scuba Dive in-housing project) to illustrate the "build software to fit you, then skin it to the next customer" thesis. Pricing landed: ~$300 implementation + ~$10/mo, optionally with a self-serve admin panel (or just text Austin for edits). Flint also floated productizing the model into its own entity and a go-to-market partner chasing ~$100K/yr contracts, plus a future data-automation / custom-CRM idea (Flint to send a Loom). Design direction: drop the yellow → black & white with meaningful accent colors that pop, industrial + "Apple touch," showroom feel. Next: Austin mocks up five design versions.

actionItems.action: Mock up 5 website design versions (industrial + Apple, showroom feel).
Send a Loom video of the existing tool/process for the automation idea.
Pick a design version from the mockups.
Build the site; drop WP/Elementor; point the Bluehost domain.
